# Run a suite of model diagnostics

<small>Source: [`man/runDiagnostics.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/runDiagnostics.Rd) · Help: `?runDiagnostics`</small>

Combines heteroscedasticity checks with tests for collinearity, nonlinearity and influential observations.

## Usage

```r
runDiagnostics(
  model,
  data = NULL,
  tests = c("white", "koenker"),
  power = 2:3,
  use_cache = TRUE,
  chunk_threshold_mb = Inf,
  chunk_size = 10000,
  progress = interactive()
)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted `lm`, or a `glm` with the Gaussian family and the identity link, or a formula. The tests refuse a `glm` of any other family or link since 0.15.0.

`data`
:   Optional data frame if `model` is a formula.

`tests`
:   Heteroscedasticity tests to run. Defaults to the White and Koenker tests, the default of [`runHeteroTests`](runHeteroTests.md); it was the White and the classical Breusch-Pagan tests up to 0.14.0.

`power`
:   Powers for `performRESETTest`.

`use_cache`
:   Logical flag forwarded to [`runHeteroTests`](runHeteroTests.md) controlling whether cached diagnostic results may be reused.

`chunk_threshold_mb`
:   Size of the data in megabytes above which [`runHeteroTests`](runHeteroTests.md) runs the streaming forms of the White, Breusch-Pagan and Koenker tests. The default, `Inf`, never streams; give a finite value to ask for them. Up to 0.15.0 the default was `100`.

`chunk_size`
:   Integer chunk size supplied to [`runHeteroTests`](runHeteroTests.md) when the streaming tests run.

`progress`
:   Logical flag controlling whether textual progress indicators are displayed during long-running operations.

## Value

A list with the results of all diagnostics.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
runDiagnostics(mpg ~ wt + qsec, mtcars)
```
